rules: The R2004 section map identifies the HEADER section and its pages.
The decoded AcDb:Header envelope contains a begin sentinel, declared data size, CRC, and end sentinel; the logical section boundary determines whether any bytes remain unclaimed.

source.provenanceLimit: The file is from a local ACadSharp sample checkout; its producer and source-generation provenance were not established. It is not a repository fixture.

implementationObservation.observation: The reader decoded and parsed the HEADER envelope with zero unclaimed bytes. Whole-file DXF export later stopped at strict IMAGEDEF/reactor source-correlation preflight; that later failure does not establish a HEADER failure.
